# Icon

Renders one Material Symbols Outlined glyph — use it anywhere SuDu AI shows an icon; never hand-roll an SVG.

`SuDuAI.Icon` · Core

## Use

```jsx
<SuDuAI.Icon name="…" />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="SuDuAI.Icon" name="…"></x-import>
```

## Notes

Material Symbols Outlined glyph, the icon system used throughout SuDu AI.

## Props (IconProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `name` * | `string` | Material Symbols ligature name, e.g. "smart_toy", "bolt", "database". |
| `size` | `number` | Pixel size; also drives the optical-size axis. Default 20. |
| `fill` | `0 \| 1` | FILL axis, 0 (outlined) or 1 (filled). Default 0. |
| `weight` | `number` | Weight axis 100–700. Default 400. |
| `color` | `string` | Glyph color. Default currentColor. |
